label: SYNTHETIC — not a real party. A sandbox rulebook for a subcontractor's progress-payment draw, written from the withheld SPEC.md (2026-11-12) for contract schedule lines L1-L5, CO-01 and CO-02; it describes no real payer.

rules.description: R1 required documents: schedule of values, pay application, a signed inspection sign-off for this draw (draw number or period end), the prior-draw lien waiver and the draw register are on file
rules.condition: sov_ref == sov_ref and reg_ref == reg_ref and lw_draw == lw_draw and insp_signed == True and (insp_draw == pay_draw or insp_end == pay_end)

rules.description: R2 contract reference agrees: the schedule of values carries the pay application's contract reference
rules.condition: pay_ref == sov_ref

rules.description: R2 contract reference agrees: the inspection carries the pay application's contract reference
rules.condition: pay_ref == insp_ref

rules.description: R2 contract reference agrees: the lien waiver carries the pay application's contract reference
rules.condition: pay_ref == lw_ref

rules.description: R2 contract reference agrees: the register carries the pay application's contract reference
rules.condition: pay_ref == reg_ref

rules.description: R3 draw sequence, for draw 1: the last settled draw is 0
rules.condition: pay_draw != 1 or ('settled' not in s1 and 'settled' not in s2 and 'settled' not in s3 and 'settled' not in s4 and 'settled' not in s5 and 'settled' not in s6)

rules.description: R3 draw sequence, for draw 2: the last settled draw is 1
rules.condition: pay_draw != 2 or ('settled' in s1 and 'settled' not in s2 and 'settled' not in s3 and 'settled' not in s4 and 'settled' not in s5 and 'settled' not in s6)

rules.description: R3 draw sequence, for draw 3: the last settled draw is 2
rules.condition: pay_draw != 3 or ('settled' in s2 and 'settled' not in s3 and 'settled' not in s4 and 'settled' not in s5 and 'settled' not in s6)

rules.description: R3 draw sequence, for draw 4: the last settled draw is 3
rules.condition: pay_draw != 4 or ('settled' in s3 and 'settled' not in s4 and 'settled' not in s5 and 'settled' not in s6)

rules.description: R3 draw sequence, for draw 5: the last settled draw is 4
rules.condition: pay_draw != 5 or ('settled' in s4 and 'settled' not in s5 and 'settled' not in s6)

rules.description: R3 draw sequence, for draw 6: the last settled draw is 5
rules.condition: pay_draw != 6 or ('settled' in s5 and 'settled' not in s6)

rules.description: R3 draw sequence: this rulebook reads the register's draws 1 to 6 only
rules.condition: pay_draw >= 1 and pay_draw <= 6

rules.description: R4 L1 percent complete is within 2 points of what inspection observed
rules.condition: pc_l1 == 0 or pc_l1 <= ob_l1 + 2

rules.description: R4 L2 percent complete is within 2 points of what inspection observed
rules.condition: pc_l2 == 0 or pc_l2 <= ob_l2 + 2

rules.description: R4 L3 percent complete is within 2 points of what inspection observed
rules.condition: pc_l3 == 0 or pc_l3 <= ob_l3 + 2

rules.description: R4 L4 percent complete is within 2 points of what inspection observed
rules.condition: pc_l4 == 0 or pc_l4 <= ob_l4 + 2

rules.description: R4 L5 percent complete is within 2 points of what inspection observed
rules.condition: pc_l5 == 0 or pc_l5 <= ob_l5 + 2

rules.description: R4 CO-01 percent complete is within 2 points of what inspection observed
rules.condition: sum(pc_co01) == 0 or (count(ob_co01) == 1 and sum(pc_co01) <= sum(ob_co01) + 2)

rules.description: R4 CO-02 percent complete is within 2 points of what inspection observed
rules.condition: sum(pc_co02) == 0 or (count(ob_co02) == 1 and sum(pc_co02) <= sum(ob_co02) + 2)

rules.description: R5 amount arithmetic: the amount requested equals gross minus retainage within one cent (change orders CO-01-approved.CO-02-approved)
rules.condition: 'yes' not in ok_co01 or 'yes' not in ok_co02 or abs(pay_req - (sv_l1 * pc_l1 / 100 - pb_l1 + sv_l2 * pc_l2 / 100 - pb_l2 + sv_l3 * pc_l3 / 100 - pb_l3 + sv_l4 * pc_l4 / 100 - pb_l4 + sv_l5 * pc_l5 / 100 - pb_l5 + sv_co01 * sum(pc_co01) / 100 - sum(pb_co01) + sv_co02 * sum(pc_co02) / 100 - sum(pb_co02)) * (100 - ret_pct) / 100) <= 0.01

rules.description: R5 amount arithmetic: the retainage withheld equals the retainage percent of the gross within one cent (change orders CO-01-approved.CO-02-approved)
rules.condition: 'yes' not in ok_co01 or 'yes' not in ok_co02 or abs(pay_ret - (sv_l1 * pc_l1 / 100 - pb_l1 + sv_l2 * pc_l2 / 100 - pb_l2 + sv_l3 * pc_l3 / 100 - pb_l3 + sv_l4 * pc_l4 / 100 - pb_l4 + sv_l5 * pc_l5 / 100 - pb_l5 + sv_co01 * sum(pc_co01) / 100 - sum(pb_co01) + sv_co02 * sum(pc_co02) / 100 - sum(pb_co02)) * ret_pct / 100) <= 0.01

rules.description: R5 amount arithmetic: the amount requested equals gross minus retainage within one cent (change orders CO-01-approved.CO-02-not-approved)
rules.condition: 'yes' not in ok_co01 or 'yes' in ok_co02 or abs(pay_req - (sv_l1 * pc_l1 / 100 - pb_l1 + sv_l2 * pc_l2 / 100 - pb_l2 + sv_l3 * pc_l3 / 100 - pb_l3 + sv_l4 * pc_l4 / 100 - pb_l4 + sv_l5 * pc_l5 / 100 - pb_l5 + sv_co01 * sum(pc_co01) / 100 - sum(pb_co01) + 0 - sum(pb_co02)) * (100 - ret_pct) / 100) <= 0.01

rules.description: R5 amount arithmetic: the retainage withheld equals the retainage percent of the gross within one cent (change orders CO-01-approved.CO-02-not-approved)
rules.condition: 'yes' not in ok_co01 or 'yes' in ok_co02 or abs(pay_ret - (sv_l1 * pc_l1 / 100 - pb_l1 + sv_l2 * pc_l2 / 100 - pb_l2 + sv_l3 * pc_l3 / 100 - pb_l3 + sv_l4 * pc_l4 / 100 - pb_l4 + sv_l5 * pc_l5 / 100 - pb_l5 + sv_co01 * sum(pc_co01) / 100 - sum(pb_co01) + 0 - sum(pb_co02)) * ret_pct / 100) <= 0.01

rules.description: R5 amount arithmetic: the amount requested equals gross minus retainage within one cent (change orders CO-01-not-approved.CO-02-approved)
rules.condition: 'yes' in ok_co01 or 'yes' not in ok_co02 or abs(pay_req - (sv_l1 * pc_l1 / 100 - pb_l1 + sv_l2 * pc_l2 / 100 - pb_l2 + sv_l3 * pc_l3 / 100 - pb_l3 + sv_l4 * pc_l4 / 100 - pb_l4 + sv_l5 * pc_l5 / 100 - pb_l5 + 0 - sum(pb_co01) + sv_co02 * sum(pc_co02) / 100 - sum(pb_co02)) * (100 - ret_pct) / 100) <= 0.01

rules.description: R5 amount arithmetic: the retainage withheld equals the retainage percent of the gross within one cent (change orders CO-01-not-approved.CO-02-approved)
rules.condition: 'yes' in ok_co01 or 'yes' not in ok_co02 or abs(pay_ret - (sv_l1 * pc_l1 / 100 - pb_l1 + sv_l2 * pc_l2 / 100 - pb_l2 + sv_l3 * pc_l3 / 100 - pb_l3 + sv_l4 * pc_l4 / 100 - pb_l4 + sv_l5 * pc_l5 / 100 - pb_l5 + 0 - sum(pb_co01) + sv_co02 * sum(pc_co02) / 100 - sum(pb_co02)) * ret_pct / 100) <= 0.01

rules.description: R5 amount arithmetic: the amount requested equals gross minus retainage within one cent (change orders CO-01-not-approved.CO-02-not-approved)
rules.condition: 'yes' in ok_co01 or 'yes' in ok_co02 or abs(pay_req - (sv_l1 * pc_l1 / 100 - pb_l1 + sv_l2 * pc_l2 / 100 - pb_l2 + sv_l3 * pc_l3 / 100 - pb_l3 + sv_l4 * pc_l4 / 100 - pb_l4 + sv_l5 * pc_l5 / 100 - pb_l5 + 0 - sum(pb_co01) + 0 - sum(pb_co02)) * (100 - ret_pct) / 100) <= 0.01

rules.description: R5 amount arithmetic: the retainage withheld equals the retainage percent of the gross within one cent (change orders CO-01-not-approved.CO-02-not-approved)
rules.condition: 'yes' in ok_co01 or 'yes' in ok_co02 or abs(pay_ret - (sv_l1 * pc_l1 / 100 - pb_l1 + sv_l2 * pc_l2 / 100 - pb_l2 + sv_l3 * pc_l3 / 100 - pb_l3 + sv_l4 * pc_l4 / 100 - pb_l4 + sv_l5 * pc_l5 / 100 - pb_l5 + 0 - sum(pb_co01) + 0 - sum(pb_co02)) * ret_pct / 100) <= 0.01

rules.description: R5 amount arithmetic, for draw 1: previously billed over all lines equals the register's gross billed for draws 1 to 0 within one cent
rules.condition: pay_draw != 1 or abs(pb_l1 + pb_l2 + pb_l3 + pb_l4 + pb_l5 + sum(pb_co01) + sum(pb_co02) - (0)) <= 0.01

rules.description: R5 amount arithmetic, for draw 2: previously billed over all lines equals the register's gross billed for draws 1 to 1 within one cent
rules.condition: pay_draw != 2 or abs(pb_l1 + pb_l2 + pb_l3 + pb_l4 + pb_l5 + sum(pb_co01) + sum(pb_co02) - (sum(g1))) <= 0.01

rules.description: R5 amount arithmetic, for draw 3: previously billed over all lines equals the register's gross billed for draws 1 to 2 within one cent
rules.condition: pay_draw != 3 or abs(pb_l1 + pb_l2 + pb_l3 + pb_l4 + pb_l5 + sum(pb_co01) + sum(pb_co02) - (sum(g1) + sum(g2))) <= 0.01

rules.description: R5 amount arithmetic, for draw 4: previously billed over all lines equals the register's gross billed for draws 1 to 3 within one cent
rules.condition: pay_draw != 4 or abs(pb_l1 + pb_l2 + pb_l3 + pb_l4 + pb_l5 + sum(pb_co01) + sum(pb_co02) - (sum(g1) + sum(g2) + sum(g3))) <= 0.01

rules.description: R5 amount arithmetic, for draw 5: previously billed over all lines equals the register's gross billed for draws 1 to 4 within one cent
rules.condition: pay_draw != 5 or abs(pb_l1 + pb_l2 + pb_l3 + pb_l4 + pb_l5 + sum(pb_co01) + sum(pb_co02) - (sum(g1) + sum(g2) + sum(g3) + sum(g4))) <= 0.01

rules.description: R5 amount arithmetic, for draw 6: previously billed over all lines equals the register's gross billed for draws 1 to 5 within one cent
rules.condition: pay_draw != 6 or abs(pb_l1 + pb_l2 + pb_l3 + pb_l4 + pb_l5 + sum(pb_co01) + sum(pb_co02) - (sum(g1) + sum(g2) + sum(g3) + sum(g4) + sum(g5))) <= 0.01

rules.description: R6 CO-01 is billed only if the schedule of values records it approved: yes
rules.condition: sum(pc_co01) == 0 or 'yes' in ok_co01

rules.description: R6 CO-02 is billed only if the schedule of values records it approved: yes
rules.condition: sum(pc_co02) == 0 or 'yes' in ok_co02

rules.description: R7 prior-draw lien waiver, for draw 2: it is for draw 1, signed, and waives the register's net paid for draw 1
rules.condition: pay_draw != 2 or (lw_draw == 1 and lw_signed == True and count(n1) == 1 and abs(lw_amount - sum(n1)) <= 0.01)

rules.description: R7 prior-draw lien waiver, for draw 3: it is for draw 2, signed, and waives the register's net paid for draw 2
rules.condition: pay_draw != 3 or (lw_draw == 2 and lw_signed == True and count(n2) == 1 and abs(lw_amount - sum(n2)) <= 0.01)

rules.description: R7 prior-draw lien waiver, for draw 4: it is for draw 3, signed, and waives the register's net paid for draw 3
rules.condition: pay_draw != 4 or (lw_draw == 3 and lw_signed == True and count(n3) == 1 and abs(lw_amount - sum(n3)) <= 0.01)

rules.description: R7 prior-draw lien waiver, for draw 5: it is for draw 4, signed, and waives the register's net paid for draw 4
rules.condition: pay_draw != 5 or (lw_draw == 4 and lw_signed == True and count(n4) == 1 and abs(lw_amount - sum(n4)) <= 0.01)

rules.description: R7 prior-draw lien waiver, for draw 6: it is for draw 5, signed, and waives the register's net paid for draw 5
rules.condition: pay_draw != 6 or (lw_draw == 5 and lw_signed == True and count(n5) == 1 and abs(lw_amount - sum(n5)) <= 0.01)

rules.description: R8 no blocking punch item: no open punch item is marked blocking: yes (items 1 to 6 read)
rules.condition: punch_open == count(pk1) + count(pk2) + count(pk3) + count(pk4) + count(pk5) + count(pk6) and 'yes' not in pk1 and 'yes' not in pk2 and 'yes' not in pk3 and 'yes' not in pk4 and 'yes' not in pk5 and 'yes' not in pk6

rules.description: R9 duplicate, for draw 1: the register holds no draw 1 that is open or settled
rules.condition: pay_draw != 1 or reg_ref != pay_ref or ('open' not in s1 and 'settled' not in s1)

rules.description: R9 duplicate, for draw 2: the register holds no draw 2 that is open or settled
rules.condition: pay_draw != 2 or reg_ref != pay_ref or ('open' not in s2 and 'settled' not in s2)

rules.description: R9 duplicate, for draw 3: the register holds no draw 3 that is open or settled
rules.condition: pay_draw != 3 or reg_ref != pay_ref or ('open' not in s3 and 'settled' not in s3)

rules.description: R9 duplicate, for draw 4: the register holds no draw 4 that is open or settled
rules.condition: pay_draw != 4 or reg_ref != pay_ref or ('open' not in s4 and 'settled' not in s4)

rules.description: R9 duplicate, for draw 5: the register holds no draw 5 that is open or settled
rules.condition: pay_draw != 5 or reg_ref != pay_ref or ('open' not in s5 and 'settled' not in s5)

rules.description: R9 duplicate, for draw 6: the register holds no draw 6 that is open or settled
rules.condition: pay_draw != 6 or reg_ref != pay_ref or ('open' not in s6 and 'settled' not in s6)

disputes.description: R4 L1: a party's recorded position on the observed percent, not recorded resolved, would change R4's outcome
disputes.condition: 'L1' in dsp_line and 'open' in dsp_status and (pc_l1 == 0 or pc_l1 <= ob_l1 + 2) != (pc_l1 == 0 or pc_l1 <= sum(dsp_value) + 2)

disputes.condition: 'L2' in dsp_line and 'open' in dsp_status and (pc_l2 == 0 or pc_l2 <= ob_l2 + 2) != (pc_l2 == 0 or pc_l2 <= sum(dsp_value) + 2)
disputes.name: dsp_position

disputes.description: R4 L3: a party's recorded position on the observed percent, not recorded resolved, would change R4's outcome

disputes.name: dsp_position

disputes.condition: 'L4' in dsp_line and 'open' in dsp_status and (pc_l4 == 0 or pc_l4 <= ob_l4 + 2) != (pc_l4 == 0 or pc_l4 <= sum(dsp_value) + 2)
disputes.name: dsp_position

disputes.condition: 'L5' in dsp_line and 'open' in dsp_status and (pc_l5 == 0 or pc_l5 <= ob_l5 + 2) != (pc_l5 == 0 or pc_l5 <= sum(dsp_value) + 2)
disputes.name: dsp_position

disputes.name: dsp_position

acceptance.description: the payer's recorded decision accepts the draw

routing.action: decline, naming each failed rule and the facts that failed it; a person tells the subcontractor
hold, naming the disputed fact, each party's recorded position and the rule that turns on it; no settlement is prepared until it is resolved
ask for exactly the missing facts, each with the document that should carry it
record acceptance and prepare a settlement for the amount requested, then wait until the payment is observed; the payment itself is a person's act
